errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: An unexpected error occurred while rendering this view. You can retry, or reload the app if it keeps happening.

errors.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check your credentials or SSH key and try again.
errors.branch_exists: A branch with this name already exists.
errors.clone_destination_exists: That repository folder already exists. Choose another name or destination.
errors.clone_destination_invalid: Fjord cannot create the repository in that destination.
errors.clone_registration_failed: The repository was cloned on disk but could not be added to the workspace. Your cloned files were kept.
errors.clone_request_invalid: Check the repository URL, destination, and folder name.
errors.create_repository_destination_invalid: Fjord cannot initialize a repository in that destination.
errors.create_repository_destination_not_empty: That repository folder is not empty. Choose an empty folder or another name.
errors.create_repository_registration_failed: The repository was created on disk but could not be added to the workspace. Your files were kept.
errors.create_repository_request_invalid: Check the repository folder name and initial branch.
errors.database_error: Fjord could not save its data. Try again or restart the app if the problem continues.
errors.diff_tool_name_invalid: Enter a Git difftool name, such as meld — not a path or a command.
errors.diff_tool_not_configured: Git could not resolve the difftool {{tool}}.
errors.git_error: Git could not complete the operation. Check the repository state and try again.
errors.git_auth_failed: Git authentication failed. Check your credential helper, token, or SSH key.
errors.git_auth_required: Git needs authentication. Complete the credential prompt and try again.
errors.git_certificate_failed: Git could not verify the server certificate.
errors.git_environment_error: Fjord could not inspect the Git environment.
errors.git_executable_invalid: The selected Git executable is invalid.
errors.git_executable_not_found: Git was not found. Select the installed Git executable.
errors.git_force_lease_failed: Someone else pushed to this branch. Fetch and review the new remote commits before trying again.
errors.git_network_unavailable: The Git server is unreachable. Check the network or VPN.
errors.git_non_fast_forward: The push was rejected because the remote branch has newer commits.
errors.git_permission_denied: The Git server denied permission for this operation.
errors.git_process_spawn_failed: Fjord could not start the Git process.
errors.git_proxy_failed: Git could not connect through the configured proxy.
errors.git_remote_error: The remote Git operation failed. Open diagnostics for details.
errors.git_remote_rejected: The remote server rejected the update.
errors.git_repository_ownership: Git refused this repository because it is owned by another account. Verify the folder, then change its ownership or add it to Git's safe.directory list.
errors.git_repository_not_found: The remote Git repository was not found.
errors.git_ssh_key_unavailable: No usable SSH key or agent was found.
errors.ide_launch_failed: The IDE could not be opened. Check its installation and settings.
errors.ide_not_allowed: This IDE command is not allowed. Select a supported IDE in Settings.
errors.merge_conflict: The operation stopped because of merge conflicts. Resolve them before continuing.
errors.merge_tool_failed: The merge tool could not be opened. Check its Git configuration.
errors.no_conflicts: There are no merge conflicts to resolve.
errors.no_ide_available: No supported IDE was found. Select one in Settings.
errors.no_terminal_available: No terminal application was found on this computer.
errors.no_upstream: The current branch has no upstream branch. Publish it first.
errors.not_a_git_repository: The selected folder is not a Git repository.
errors.nothing_to_commit: There are no staged changes to commit.
errors.nothing_to_stash: There are no local changes to stash.
errors.operation_not_in_progress: There is no Git operation to control.
errors.operation_step_failed: Git could not complete this operation step. Open diagnostics for details.
errors.repository_already_added: This repository is already in the selected workspace.
errors.repository_discovery_failed: Repositories could not be scanned in the selected folder.
errors.repository_not_found: The repository could not be found. It may have been moved or removed.
errors.remote_name_exists: A remote with this name already exists.
errors.remote_request_invalid: Check the remote name and repository URL.
errors.stash_empty: There are no saved stashes to apply.
errors.stash_not_found: That stash no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
errors.stash_ambiguous: More than one stash entry points at the same commit; Fjord will not guess which one you meant.
errors.stash_file_conflicted: This file has unresolved conflicts. Resolve them first.
errors.stash_file_unsupported_git: Exact path-scoped stash creation requires Git 2.23 or newer.
errors.stash_scope_empty: Select at least one file to stash.
errors.stash_concurrent_update: The repository changed while the stash was being created. Nothing was stashed.
errors.stash_recovery_failed: Stash creation failed and Fjord could not fully restore the repository. Review your staged and working changes before continuing.
errors.stash_scope_unrepresentable: The state of {{path}} cannot be represented exactly, so no stash was created.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again or restart Fjord if the problem continues.
errors.workspace_not_found: The workspace could not be found. Refresh the app and try again.
errors.log_folder_unavailable: The log folder could not be opened. Open the application data folder manually.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Choose how Fjord follows your desktop appearance.

locale.label: Language
locale.description: Fjord uses this language throughout the application.

performanceDiagnostics.label: Performance diagnostics
performanceDiagnostics.title: Record performance traces
performanceDiagnostics.description: Keeps the latest interaction timings in memory. Traces contain identifiers and durations only, and are cleared when disabled.

git.executableDescription: Choose the Git installation used for local commands, remote operations, and authentication.
git.notFoundDescription: Fjord uses system Git for remote operations and authentication.
git.invalidPathDescription: The Git executable selected in Settings could not be run. Local and remote Git operations are unavailable until you choose a working path or reset it.
git.environmentDescription: Fjord uses your existing credential helpers, SSH agent, and proxy configuration.
git.askpassMissingDescription: The bundled askpass helper is missing, so Git cannot ask for credentials through Fjord. Operations that need a prompt will fail until the application is reinstalled.
git.connectionDescription: Verify that the selected repository can reach its configured origin.
git.noRepositories: Add a repository to test its origin connection.
git.repositoryOwnershipSummary: Review Git's trust rule before allowing a repository owned by another account.
git.repositoryOwnershipDescription: If Git reports that a repository is owned by another account, verify who owns the folder first. Change the folder ownership when it is wrong, or explicitly trust a known repository with:
git.repositoryOwnershipWarning: Only add a path to safe.directory after verifying that you trust the repository and its owner.

defaultIde.label: Default IDE
defaultIde.description: Choose the editor Fjord opens by default.
defaultIde.customDescription: Use a command that is not included in the built-in editor list.

diffTool.label: External diff tool
diffTool.auto: Use the tool configured in Git
diffTool.invalidName: Enter a Git difftool name, such as meld — not a path or a command.

about.logsDescription: Logs contain operational diagnostics, repository names, paths, and timings, but never file or diff contents.
about.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
